question: Count the total number of beverage brands listed in KO's FY2022 and FY2024 filings by category (sparkling soft drinks; water, sports, coffee and tea; juice, value-added dairy and plant-based beverages). answer: KO FY2022: Sparkling soft drinks: 8 brands; water, sports, coffee and tea: 17 brands; juice, value-added dairy and plant-based: 6 brands (AdeS, Del Valle, fairlife, innocent, Minute Maid, Minute Maid Pulpy, Simply) – total 31. KO FY2024: Sparkling soft drinks: 8 brands; water, sports, coffee and tea: 18 brands (added Crystal); juice, value-added dairy and plant-based: 7 brands (added Core Power, removed AdeS? Actually AdeS not listed in FY2024, but list includes Core Power, Del Valle, fairlife, innocent, Maaza, Minute Maid, Minute Maid Pulpy, Simply – that is 8? Let's recount: Core Power, Del Valle, fairlife, innocent, Maaza, Minute Maid, Minute Maid Pulpy, Simply = 8. So total 8+18+8=34, an increase of 3 brands. WMT's FY2022 filing presents three fiscal years (2021, 2022, 2023); WMT's FY2024 filing also presents three fiscal years (2022, 2023, 2024) – no difference in count. The brand portfolio expansion at KO over time suggests growth strategies that are not directly comparable to WMT's stable fiscal year presentation.
